== Summary ==
Identified: [[Logan Pietig]] (standing at left, wavy brown hair and a black Under Armour shirt; same face as [[:File:2022 World Championship team tournament 4.jpg]]); [[Brian Fred]] (seated, bald, glasses, a face mask, and a Buffalo Bills shirt; same clothing as [[:File:2022 World Championship team tournament 4.jpg]]); and [[Jonny Chu]] (seated, glasses and a Buffalo Bills hoodie). Remaining faces unlabeled: the player in a red tee and a tan mask at left; the young player in a matching Bills shirt and glasses at right; and the players in the background.
The Friday-night team tournament: players in matching buffalo shirts, with Players Committee card sheets on the table.

* '''Event:''' [[2022 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2022-10-18
* '''Camera date:''' 2022-10-14 20:08 (from the original file name)
* '''Identification:''' the people are not named in the post.
